headline: Approval of West Woods LED project, keyboard piano donation, and school building use requests.
summary: The agenda includes an update on the Special Education Review proposal sent to the Legislative Council. Consent items include the West Woods LED Project and two building use requests.
items: Update on the Special Education Review proposal sent to the Legislative Council
Consent: approval of West Woods LED Project
Consent: approval of donation of a Donner 88 Keyboard Piano to the Fine and Performing Arts Department
Consent: approval of Hamden Parks and Rec use of the Hamden Middle School gymnasium on Mondays from October 19, 2026 to May 10, 2027, 6:30-9:30 pm, for volleyball
Consent: approval of Whitneyville Civic Association use of the boardroom at 60 Putnam Ave. on October 15, 2026, February 21 and April 15, 2027, 7-8:30 pm, for meetings
location: Boardroom at 60 Putnam Ave. Hamden, CT

HAMDEN BOARD OF EDUCATION 
ANNOUNCEMENT OF BOARD OF EDUCATION MEETING AGENDA 
TUESDAY, OCTOBER 13, 2026 
Revised 
Public Session:  7:00 PM  
Location- Boardroom at 60 Putnam Ave. Hamden, CT 
 
To join the meeting virtually, please click the link below to join the webinar: 
https://hamden.zoom.us/j/84562760328?pwd=BwCWxW1AKNjuEahbCzZsUkhbYBNqZK.1  
Passcode:401934 
 
Telephone: +1 301 715 8592, +1 305 224 1968, +1 309 205 3325, +1 312 626 6799, +1 646 558 8656 US  
Webinar ID: 845 6276 0328 
Passcode: 401934 
 
For those who wish to make Public Comments:  
Time will be allotted for public comments at the beginning of the meeting. We ask that public comments be limited 
to no more than 3 minutes in length. You may also submit your comment in writing. Public comments should be 
sent to PublicInput@hamden.org, with the message's subject stating the meeting's name and date (for example, 
“May 12 Operations Committee Meeting”). Public comments will be accepted up to 1 p.m. the day of the meeting.  
Please note the following: 
• The name and Hamden address of the person submitting public comment must be included in the message.  
• Remarks should be brief and concise, with a maximum length of three minutes (about 450 characters).  
• Comments should start with a 2-3 sentence summary. The summary will be read instead of the entire 
message if there is a large number of comments and reading each of them in their entirety would extend 
beyond the time allotted for public comment.  
 
1. Call to order and roll call 
2. Pledge of Allegiance 
3. Additions to the Agenda 
4. Public Comments on Agenda Items  
5. Correspondence 
6. Approval of minutes from the June 9, 2026 Board of Education meeting  and the September 8, 2026 
Board of Education meeting 
7. Chairperson’s report 
8. Student Representative report  
9. Superintendent’s Report  
10. Committee reports 
a. ACES/Wintergreen  
b. Curriculum Committee 
c. Finance Committee 
d. Goals and Evaluations Committee 
e. Operations Committee 
f. Personnel Committee 
g. Policy Committee 
 
11. Information Item: 
a. Update on the status of the Special Education Review proposal sent to the Legislative Council  
 
12. Action Items 
a. Consent Agenda 
i. Approval of West Woods LED Project (Operations Committee, October 2026) 
ii. Approval of the donation of a Donner 88 Keyboard Piano to the Fine and Performing
Arts Department (Operations Committee, October 2026) 
iii. Approval of the building use by the Hamden Parks and Rec to use gymnasium at 
Hamden Middle School on Mondays from October 19, 2026-May 10, 2027 from 6:30-
9:30pm for Volleyball (Operations Committee, October 2026) 
iv. Approval of the building use by the Whitneyville Civic Association to use the 
boardroom at 60 Putnam Ave. on October 15, 2026, February 21 and April 15, 2027 
from 7-8:30pm for meetings (Operations Committee, October 2026) 
 
 
13. Adjournment
